title: AgentGuard
description: Dual-stream anomaly detection for LLM agent servers. It fuses OS telemetry and LLM action logs through a Mamba + Transformer architecture to catch prompt injection, data exfiltration and resource-abuse attacks that are invisible to either signal alone.

title: SmartHealth
description: An all-in-one mobile health-management app that streamlines diet, medication and recovery tracking, offers personalised AI-driven suggestions, and connects users with nearby medical facilities.

title: ScamSniper
description: An AI-powered scam detection and awareness platform that analyses messages and content to flag potential scams and help users stay safe online.

title: C4T6-HotelBooking
description: A full-stack hotel booking platform supporting hotel search, room booking and reservation management, built with a modern React front end and a Node/Express + PostgreSQL backend. Mentored by Ascenda and SUTD Faculty.
